additional_info.body:
Dear Johannes,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Shrey
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2 / S9 313875948001
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
8qgG8Z
Problem Description
: LED issue.
Troubleshooting
: Please find the below steps for troubleshooting
1. Please check the FC212 fuse whether it is red or green.
2. Check the connections of 24V0 circuit that is specifically for LED on XD206 terminal 5th pin.
3.Please check KF215 wiring connections.
4. Please check XD213 wiring connections.
5. Please carry one spare LED Dimmer with you for the site intervention. MLFB :  8EM5903-0AA01-5AA8
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0393851 ﻿from the
